target.title: fix(worker): bound coordinator lease scans
target.body:
Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/862

## Summary

- restore hibernated bridge sockets from their exact referenced lease records instead of materializing the complete historical lease set
- page Azure orphan-sweep lease reads and retain only active leases plus terminal ownership records matching the current provider inventory
- preserve fail-closed orphan deletion: provider tags alone remain report-only

## Root cause

Production Worker tailing reproduced the reported HTTP 1101 response and showed the Fleet Durable Object exceeding its isolate memory limit. Bridge restoration loaded every historical lease before handling the create-recovery poll, repeatedly resetting the isolate. Azure orphan maintenance used the same unbounded history shape.

## Verification

- `npm test --prefix worker -- --run test/fleet.test.ts test/coordinator-runtime.test.ts test/cloudflare-dynamic-worker-runner.test.ts` (458 tests)
- `npm test --prefix worker` (796 tests)
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --parallel-tests 'npm test --prefix worker' --stream-engine-output` (clean; no accepted/actionable findings)

## Live gate

After exact-head CI, deploy this Worker revision, confirm coordinator health/history no longer resets the Durable Object, create/use/release an Azure lease, run the Azure orphan sweep, and verify zero cloud residue.
